user.title: Add ArkViz
user.description: Adds ArkViz to the sidebar and at /arkviz-app/ on this address, where you draw a floorplan of your home and control your lights and devices from it. The plan you draw is kept in Home Assistant, so every screen shows the same one.

init.title: ArkViz
init.description: ArkViz is always at /arkviz-app/ on this address, for a wall panel or a full screen.
